bluetooth: Export GATT attribute interfaces as GATT client role In order to make the GATT attributes visible to D-Bus clients, this includes the following changes. - Adding gatt_interface_handler to export the discovered GATT services characteristics and descriptor to D-Bus - Implementation of observer mechanism in gatt.cc so that gatt_interface_handler can get notified on changes on GATT attributes - Determining how the D-Bus object properties should be updated and exported. We decided to go for the module where the interface handler needs to proactively go through all properties and update them. vm_tools: concierge: do not keep xattrs/fflags in VM exports When exporting VMs, do not attempt to store extended attributes or "fflags" (chattr-style attributes). The files that are being archived should be normal files, aside from having the "encrypted" chattr flag set, which can't be preserved in an archive anyway. When libarchive adds files with these flags to a PAX-style tar file, it creates extra sections that GNU tar doesn't understand, which results in confusing error messages when extracting the tarball. Disable them to avoid adding the extra sections when using libarchive's "restricted pax" format so that the resulting tar file is cleanly extract-able with GNU tar and other tar implementations. servo: add ControlUnavailableError, has_control() This change adds its own error class for servo erros where the control is unavailable on the servod side. This simplifies some of the code as the autotest code occasionally requires bridges to ensure compatibility with older and newer servod versions.
